scientific_question: On genuine two-decision workflows, does node-level all-branch LOO reduce policy drift at a known non-causal target compared with trajectory-broadcast GRPO, while preserving the ability to learn causal target actions?

scope_correction.stage_c2: Stage C2 is treated as a successful infrastructure and exploration diagnostic, not a powered negative for the core credit thesis.
reason: Its endpoint margin became unreachable after broadcast saturated.
Its planted-needle workflow did not create meaningful credit confusion at the targeted decision.

tasks.confusion_irrelevant: The root route changes reward; the targeted digit has no effect. This is the primary credit-confusion endpoint.
tasks.confusion_redundant: Reward succeeds when either root route delta or target digit 5 succeeds.
tasks.confusion_lucky: Target digit 5 and root route are causal while an episode-level +/-1 luck term is shared by every branch.
tasks.common_random_numbers: For one ReDCO episode, root route and episode luck are sampled once and held fixed across all 11 target branches.

support_guard.failure_action: Classify the campaign as underpowered and do not reinterpret it as an algorithm failure.

arms.broadcast: Stock GRPO trajectory advantage assigned to root and target decisions.
arms.sliced: ReDCO trajectory LOO at the root and 11-branch LOO at the target with sliced replay.

design.excluded_arm: Full-suffix replay is not repeated because prior live sliced-vs-full outcome equivalence already passed; this gate isolates credit.
design.one_campaign_rule: After the first Stage C3 model call, do not retry, substitute hardware, change thresholds, or launch a second campaign.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.policy_distribution: For each recorded prefix, normalize exact vLLM temperature-2 probabilities over digit tokens 0-7 and compute Jensen-Shannon divergence from the shared warm start.

primary_irrelevant_target.exposure_floor: Mean broadcast JS divergence across seeds must be at least 0.002; otherwise status is underpowered.
primary_irrelevant_target.directional_effect: Mean sliced JS divergence must be at most 75% of mean broadcast JS divergence.
primary_irrelevant_target.pairwise_guard: For each seed, sliced JS may not exceed paired broadcast JS by more than 0.002.

causal_sanity.rule: On each causal probe, at least one arm must increase exact digit-5 mass by at least 0.05 from initialization.
causal_sanity.calls_to_threshold: First aligned policy-call point whose sampled evaluation target-success rate is at least 0.5.
causal_sanity.comparison: Calls-to-threshold is reported for both arms as a compute tradeoff; ReDCO is not required to beat broadcast because it receives fewer optimizer steps at matched calls.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.saturation_guard: If any exact final digit-5 mass is at least 0.98, endpoint margins are forbidden and only the frozen calls-to-threshold curve is used for sample-efficiency interpretation.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.pass: Every support, primary, causal-sanity, completeness, and aligned-evaluation check in the frozen verifier passes.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.underpowered: Either initialization support fails or the broadcast exposure floor is not met.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.fail: The gate is adequately exposed but one or more other mandatory checks fail.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.claim_limit: A pass supports reduced nuisance drift on this small mechanistic battery, not a broad population claim.

pre_model_call_checks: Run root tests, environment tests, Prime ReDCO algorithm tests, config rendering tests, and verifier tests.
Reconstruct and hash the selected merged warm start.
Render all eight configs and save their hashes before the first model call.
execution.failure_handling: After any failure, recover all existing artifacts, record the terminal result, and do not retry after a model call.
execution.artifacts: Sync all logs, metrics, rendered configs, manifests, verifier outputs, and final adapters locally. Store final adapters as independently hashed zstd files and omit redundant intermediate broadcasts.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.selection: Cheapest genuinely available non-spot 2x48GB resource observed immediately before freeze.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.
